description: Universal pixel iframe fires to insight.adsrvr.org/track/up, whose query carries advertiser ID, referrer, pixel ID, and pixel version.

params.name: adv
params.description: It is the platform advertiser ID that owns the tracking tag. The Trade Desk documents it as required on the iframe src.
params.fix_hint: Set `adv` to the advertiser ID from the generated universal pixel code.

params.name: upid
params.description: It is the universal pixel ID from the inline script. The Trade Desk documents it as required on the iframe src.
params.fix_hint: Set `upid` to the universal pixel ID from the generated tag.

params.name: ref
params.description: It is the page URL the tag fired on. The Trade Desk documents it as required, and mappings match against it.
params.fix_hint: Set `ref` to the absolute URL of the page that fired the pixel.

params.name: upv
params.description: It is The Trade Desk version number of the universal pixel. The iframe src documents it as required.
params.fix_hint: Set `upv` to the version from the generated universal pixel code, such as `3.3.0`.

params.name: order_id
params.description: Optional dynamic parameter; current and documented previous names are accepted.

params.name: value
params.description: Optional dynamic parameter; current and documented previous names are accepted.

params.name: currency
params.description: Optional dynamic parameter; current and documented previous names are accepted.

params.name: policies
params.description: Optional dynamic parameter; current and documented previous names are accepted.

params.name: region
params.description: Optional dynamic parameter; current and documented previous names are accepted.

params.name: td_values
params.description: Values beyond 64 characters are logged but truncated in reports.

params.name: method
params.description: The documented Universal Pixel iframe uses a GET navigation.
